steps.title: Port deterministic cross-group allocation into immutable plans

steps.notes: The two-group inline-root spill is deterministic; no-space, metadata-alias, and incomplete-group rejection leave the source image unchanged. A Docker-generated inline-root spill fixture applies the full plan and passes e2fsck -fn. Do not pull indexed extent-root growth into this step; it belongs to A3.

steps.title: Convert one inline unwritten extent block without allocation
verification: pager_mock proves prefix and suffix remain unwritten, the target becomes initialized, and no allocation claim or home write occurs
cargo test -p tx-ext4-format -- --test-threads=1
cargo -q xtask unit
steps.notes: Depth-0 through bounded depth-2 unwritten conversion is host-verified: full depth-1 leaves split, full inode roots grow one level, and depth-2 leaves split, carry a full parent into a non-full root, or promote a full inode root into two depth-two nodes behind a depth-three inode root. Depth-3+ conversion remains fail closed.

steps.title: Migrate captured-path extents, unwritten conversion, and recursive freeing
verification: captured-path ladder covers indexed insertion, leaf split, root growth, and validated child/key ordering
unwritten conversion preserves data allocation and changes only required extent metadata claims
recursive truncate/destroy emits descendant-first after-images and revoke order with root collapse
Linux debugfs bmap comparison and Docker-backed e2fsck -fn cover fragmented depth-2 and depth-3 fixtures
steps.notes: Depth-0 through bounded depth-2 unwritten conversion and bounded recursive truncate/destroy release are now host-verified. Recursive release validates depth/key ordering/cycles and reserved or overlapping physical ranges, emits descendant-first extent-node after-images, updates merged allocation metadata, and retains sorted revoke/deferred-free claims. A Docker debugfs fixture now creates a real depth-two unwritten tree, converts it through Tx after-images, recursively truncates it, compares its retained debugfs bmap, and passes e2fsck -fn. The same fixture now proves unlink -> destroy e2fsck cleanliness; a bounded depth-three mock proves recursive truncate revokes all descendant nodes. The full depth-two root carry is now host-verified: splitting a full leaf and parent produces four metadata-node claims and promotes the inode root to depth three. Depth-3+ conversion and crash cuts remain pending; do not add depth-specific runtime shortcuts.

steps.notes: Depth-two host runtime witnesses now cover public truncate checkpointing of the retained leaf/allocation/inode after-images and MutationHandle retention of recursive destroy deferred-free claims. PageBacked retains file-page lifecycle, ext4 retains mutation planning and JBD2 staging, and Mount retains settlement. Linux-to-Tx and Tx-to-Linux deep-shape fixtures remain required before this step can close.
